headline: Acting AG Todd Blanche faces a key test. And, ICE pauses most traffic stops
context: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche is set to appear before the Senate for his confirmation hearing. And, Immigration and Customs Enforcement has paused most traffic stops after recent deadly shootings.
